content:
incident-bot: PAGE: model-quality-regression for tenant AcmeBank in dedicated pool db-pool-02. Severity: P2. Trigger: automated quality monitor (prompt-set regression) at 2026-03-15T09:05:21Z.

oncall-manny: I’m on it. tagging folks: @Lia (Customer Success) @Alex (Runtime) @Priya (SRE). please ack and share any customer-facing context.

Lia (Customer Success): Ack. I just got a DM from AcmeBank SRE saying generation outputs are hallucinating on a critical financial-summary prompt. They reported start ~08:40 UTC and sent examples. They’re in VPC + dedicated pool (db-pool-02).

Alex (Runtime): Noted. We rolled tenant-specific quantization profile q_profile-acmebank-v3 onto db-pool-02 in a targeted rollout at 2026-03-15T07:55Z (safe window). Looks like that profile reduces precision aggressively (q4_0/4bit-mixed) for cost.

Sara: TL;DR — only AcmeBank impacted, requests still serve but quality dropped (hallucination + truncated completions). CPU/GPU metrics for the pool look normal. No infra throttles or OOMs.

Priya (SRE): I’ll run quick canary to repro. Can someone paste a failing prompt?

Lia (Customer Success): Example (sanitized): "Summarize this quarter's cashflow and list anomalies." Expected: clear bank balances / flagged suspicious transfers. Got: confident but incorrect names/amounts.

Alex (Runtime): Reproduced locally when applying q_profile-acmebank-v3 against redwood-7b-variant. Switching quantization to previous profile q_profile-acmebank-v2 (q8_0/8bit mixed) fixes the output in canary.

oncall-manny: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Revert tenant quantization profile to q_profile-acmebank-v2 (fast path) 2) Temporarily pin their routing to fp16 model variant redwood-7b-fp16-2025_12_01 as fallback 3) Run a 5m canary, validate sample prompts, then lift. Who can execute steps 1+2?

Alex (Runtime): I’ll do 1 and 2. Running control-plane rollback API now.

Alex (Runtime): COMMAND: 
```
curl -s -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/tenants/AcmeBank/profiles/revert" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"target_profile":"q_profile-acmebank-v2","reason":"prod quality regression","force":true}'
```

Alex (Runtime): API returned 202 accepted. Config change propagated to db-pool-02 controllers. Pushing routing pin:
```
# pin tenant to fallback model while we validate
rlctl route update --tenant AcmeBank --model redwood-7b-fp16-2025_12_01 --priority emergency
```

Priya (SRE): I’m attaching a short probe job against a sampled set of 25 failing prompts. Running now.

Priya (SRE): Probe results coming in — 22/25 now match expected QA baseline after revert. Two partial failures look like older unrelated prompt variants.

Lia (Customer Success): I’ve told AcmeBank we’re rolling back the quant profile and doing canary validation. They asked for ETA — I said ~15–30 min for verification and full roll back. They asked for timeline and root cause once stable.

Devon: Quick note — the change pipeline allowed tenant-scoped profile v3 to be pushed without the new canary gate enabled. That’s a process gap.

Sara: Observability: request-level token quality score (QA harness) shows sharp drop starting 2026-03-15T08:38Z for AcmeBank requests, coinciding with q_profile-v3 rollout. No other tenants show signal.

Alex (Runtime): Prev profile re-applied. Controller reports all nodes in db-pool-02 for tenant AcmeBank now using q_profile-acmebank-v2. Rolling pin removed; routing back to normal over next 2 min.

Priya (SRE): Monitoring metrics: latency and error rates unchanged. Quality probe baseline stable. Marking mitigation applied (time 2026-03-15T09:27:00Z).

Lia (Customer Success): AcmeBank confirmed results look normal on their side for the sample prompts. They’ll run a broader QA and update us.

oncall-manny: Status update for incident log: Impact: quality regression for AcmeBank only; customer-facing errors: hallucinations/truncation; start: ~08:40 UTC; mitigation: rolled back q_profile-acmebank-v3 to v2 and pinned fallback model; current state: monitoring.

Devon: Postmortem action items I’ll own: 1) Block tenant-scoped quant profile rollouts unless canary gate is enabled for dedicated pools. 2) Add tenant-specific synthetic canaries that run prior to profile flips. 3) Improve change audit (who/when).

Alex (Runtime): Engineering follow-ups: add an automated rollback path in control-plane that triggers when QA harness fails canary for >20% of sampled prompts.

Priya (SRE): Ops follow-ups: add a runbook section for tenant-specific quant regressions (fast revert + model pin + notify CS). I’ll draft and post to eng-runbooks.

Lia (Customer Success): I’ll send AcmeBank a concise incident note once postmortem draft is available. They requested no SLA credit for now but want detailed RCA.

oncall-manny: Handoff: I’m handing follow-ups to @Priya (SRE) and @Devon (Platform). I’m unassigning oncall after I update the incident tracker.

Priya (SRE): Acknowledged. I’ll keep monitoring for 24h and escalate if any regression reappears.

Sara: Quick logs snippet for root cause trace:
```
2026-03-15T07:55:12Z controller: applying profile q_profile-acmebank-v3 to tenant AcmeBank on pool db-pool-02
2026-03-15T08:38:45Z quality-harness: deviation_score spike (>=0.45) for tenant AcmeBank
2026-03-15T09:05:21Z pager: model-quality-regression (AcmeBank) triggered
```

Devon: Risk note — v3 attempted to push aggressive weight folding + asymmetric quant params for some custom layernorm patterns present in AcmeBank's fine-tuned model. We’ll add a static analyzer to reject profiles incompatible with model metadata.

oncall-manny: Closing notes: mitigation applied and validated, customer notified, follow-ups assigned. Changing incident state to MONITORING. Will update incident thread in 2h or sooner if regressions reappear. :lock:

Priya (SRE): Thanks everyone. I’ll open the postmortem skeleton and tag owners.

Lia (Customer Success): Thx — I’ll follow up with AcmeBank and share their QA results here.

Alex (Runtime): Filing a change ticket to disable auto-rollout of q_profile-acmebank-v3 across other pools until we finish the RCA.

incident-bot: Incident 1780054321 status -> MONITORING. Acknowledged participants: oncall-manny, Sara, Alex (Runtime), Priya (SRE), Devon, Lia (Customer Success)"
